issue.title: bob capture x=build panics 'pomodoro block ref names a non-entry headline' when a closed timed entry has a child Task Link
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-q5.1.1.5 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) during the snooze writer audit; independently reproduced by the bob-cli-q5.1.1 land agent on bob-cli master 6a3e5df6. Not caused by the snooze epic: the repro has no `## Snoozed` section, and the panicking path (`src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs` block-ref resolution) was last touched by 87ee683a.

## Repro (debug build)

```sh
T=$(mktemp -d); V=$T/vault; mkdir -p $V/2026 $V/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-tasks-plugin
echo '{}' > $V/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-tasks-plugin/data.json
printf 'timezone: America/New_York\n' > $T/bob.yml
printf '# 2026-10-08\n\n## Pomodoros\n\n- [ ] () — BUILD\n- [x] (**0700-0800** [t:: 60m]) — WORK\n  - [[jobs#^early]]\n' > $V/2026/20261008.md
printf -- '- [*] #task Early work ^early\n' > $V/jobs.md
BOB_CONFIG_FILE=$T/bob.yml BOB_DAY_FILE=$V/2026/20261008.md BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE=$T/vault.lock \
  BOB_NOW=2026-10-08T11:00:00-04:00 target/debug/bob capture -b $V -f json -- x=build
# thread 'main' panicked at src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs:685:21:
# pomodoro block ref names a non-entry headline   (exit 101)
```

The `x=` record outcome on `BUILD`, with a closed timed `WORK` entry that has a child Task Link, makes `PomodoroBlockTracker` resolve a `PomodoroBlockBefore::Resolve` ref to an `after` headline that is not in `post_entries`, tripping `debug_assert!(false, "pomodoro block ref names a non-entry headline")`. Release builds skip the ref (`continue`), so the `pomodoro_blocks` preview is probably wrong or missing rather than crashing. The root cause (which caller supplies the stale `after`) is not yet pinned.

## Related

Not a duplicate of closed bob-cli-dq (vanished-entry guard at a different line, triggered by in-section task status rewrites) or bob-cli-oh (task_blocks.rs:587). Add a CLI regression with this fixture.

task_type_fields.impact: Debug builds (tests, dev installs) crash on a common x= record; release builds skip the block ref so Mac Capture/Obsidian previews can show a wrong or missing pomodoro_blocks.
task_type_fields.repro: See description: closed timed WORK entry with a child link plus an untimed BUILD entry, BOB_NOW 11:00, bob capture -- x=build exits 101 in debug builds.

issue.creation_reason: A debug-build crash in an everyday capture x= record gesture, found and reproduced during snooze landing; release builds silently drop or misreport pomodoro_blocks.

payload.entry: x=build against an open BUILD above a closed timed WORK entry with a child Task Link no longer panics. record_one_member now remaps existing (created=false) next identities through file_recorded_block's drain-then-insert and pins Next refs with locate_next_headline against the filed scan so after is an entry headline. Verified: capture_pomodoro_record_preserves_closed_timed_entry_with_child (exact 2026-10-08 fixture, dry-run/real, WORK 0700-0800 plus child kept, BUILD 1035-1100 recorded), capture_pomodoro_record_preserves_childless_timed_entry, capture_pomodoro_record_preserves_reordered_closed_entry (WORK/LATER children kept, trailing BUILD not stolen). 98 pomodoro_close, 34 pomodoro_past, 23 successor_verdicts (including the ID-less cancel cases), and 41 capture::pomodoro lib tests passed. Debug assert for non-entry after remains.
